mechanism_narrative: A persistently low federal funds rate (below 0.5%) compresses discount rates for equity cash flows, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are not significantly positive in periods when FEDFUNDS < 0.5% (t-test p>0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the federal funds rate above 4.5% per annum signals a tightening monetary cycle that increases equity discount rates, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are not significantly negative in periods when FEDFUNDS > 4.5% (t-test p>0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate is below 0.5% and the CPI index is rising above 270 with a monthly increase exceeding 0.5%, the combination signals an accommodative monetary policy amid moderate inflation, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are not significantly positive in periods meeting the trigger condition (t-test p>0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In high unemployment regimes (UNRATE > 5.0%), the labor market slack suppresses wage growth and corporate profit margins, generating negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are not significantly negative in periods when UNRATE > 5.0% (t-test p>0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A positive quarterly growth rate in real GDP (as measured by the change in GDPC1) indicates a strengthening economy, which supports equity valuations and generates positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are not significantly positive in periods when GDPC1 growth is positive (t-test p>0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the industrial production index (INDPRO) exceeds 101, it indicates strong supply chain activity and robust economic output, which supports corporate earnings and generates positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are not significantly positive in periods when INDPRO > 101 (t-test p>0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A persistently low federal funds rate (below 0.5%) compresses short-term discount rates, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are not significantly positive in periods when FEDFUNDS < 0.5% (t-test p>0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A positive quarterly growth rate in real GDP (as measured by the change in GDPC1) indicates a strengthening economy, which supports equity valuations and generates positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are not significantly positive in periods when GDPC1 growth is positive (t-test p>0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
